content.about: Sudan is in northeast Africa, where the Blue and White Nile meet at Khartoum. Most of it is desert or dry savanna. Ancient Nubian kingdoms built pyramids here. It is a top gum arabic producer.

standout.text: Sudan has more pyramids than Egypt, at sites like Meroë.

didYouKnow: The two Niles meet at Khartoum.
Sudan produces much of the world's gum arabic.
